WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
)
SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) cnt3
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics ON customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_dates.d_date_sk
) AS store_customers ON c.c_customer_sk = store_customers.ss_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = filtered_dates.d_date_sk
    UNION
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = filtered_dates.d_date_sk
) AS bad_customers ON c.c_customer_sk = bad_customers.ws_bill_customer_sk
WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME')
  AND bad_customers.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NULL
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
